config.maxAgents: Maximum number of concurrently running agents per workspace (fork-bomb guardrail). tachyon.yml settings.maxAgents takes precedence when set.
config.taskNotifications.enabled: Show VS Code notifications for task create and edit events.
config.taskNotifications.events: Task events that can show VS Code notifications.
config.taskNotifications.suppressOwnChan: Do not show a task assignment notification when an agent assigns a task to itself.
config.taskNotifications.dedupeWindowMs: Suppress identical task notifications within this window in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable deduplication.
config.activity.codeTheme: Syntax-highlight palette for code blocks in the Activity view. 'auto' follows the editor's dark/light; 'dark'/'light' force a side.
config.worktrees.revealInWorkspace: Reveal each agent's isolated git worktree as a folder in this multi-root workspace while it's running, and remove it on cleanup (self-heals stale entries left by a prior reload). Only applies when the window is already multi-root — a single-folder window is left untouched to avoid forcing a reload.
config.gitPath: Path to the git binary Tachyon should spawn. Set this when the extension host's PATH doesn't include git (e.g. a truncated PATH after reload). Falls back to the git extension's git.path, then common install locations, then bare 'git' on PATH.
config.agentPane.enabled: Enable the first-party agent pane (layer 2, webview+xterm). VS Code integrated terminal remains the default open path.
config.sidebar.cardTemplate: Your personal agent-card layout. Optional, and it WINS over the project's `settings.sidebar.cardTemplate` in `tachyon.yml` — a region you do not list keeps whatever that project chose. Same versioned shape and the same validation: an invalid template is refused whole, the sidebar falls back to the project's card, and the sidebar says so.
config.sidebar.cardTemplate.version: Template schema version. Required; this Tachyon understands version 1.
config.sidebar.cardTemplate.region: Component ids for this region, in the order they should render. Omit the region to keep the project's; an empty list hides everything in it (a failure state is still re-admitted for the row it affects).
config.sidebar.cardTemplate.runtimes: Optional per-runtime overrides, keyed by runtime name. Each states `extends: default` or `extends: replace`, same as in tachyon.yml.
